detail.longDescription: Apparently AI perceives web pages primarily through the browser's # accessibility tree. I'm not sure if that's good or bad. The good: this encourages # webdev ⁠s to fill out accessibility attributes. 🥳 The bad: this encourages webdevs to fill out accessibility attributes for the purpose of SEO, not accessibility. Depending on how crazy they get about ARIA-as-an-SEO-tool, that may make the # screenReader user experience *worse*. 😬
